'''2007 US East Nationals Day 1 Kendall Halman LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kendall Halman]] at [[2007 US East Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Kendell Halman
* '''Deck name:''' Unmodifiable Values
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
